description.value: Bakerview EcoDairy, also known as EcoFarm Discovery Centre, is a non-profit working demonstration farm that operates in partnership with Science World, offering guided dairy and farm tours, field trips, kids camps, and a free outdoor petting zoo. Touring cyclists can browse the on-site Seasons Farm Market, which carries EcoDairy milk, ice cream, eggs, and grass-fed beef. The main dairy barn and some tour areas are wheelchair accessible, and the farm is open year-round.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at ecofarmbc.ca confirms the business is operating year-round as a non-profit demonstration farm, with phone 604-557-5481 and address 1356 Sumas Way, Abbotsford, BC — the phone matches OSM but the address city (Abbotsford) conflicts with the OSM community field (Chilliwack). The FAQ and tours pages confirm an on-site Seasons Farm Market selling dairy and food products. No bike-specific amenities (racks, parking, water refill, showers, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those fields remain null.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Chilliwack' but the website and address clearly place this business in Abbotsford (1356 Sumas Way, Abbotsford, BC) — OSM community assignment appears incorrect.

OSM name is 'Bakerview EcoDairy' but the website and branding use 'EcoFarm' / 'EcoFarm Discovery Centre' (matching OSM alt_name). The OSM primary name may be outdated or refer to the dairy component only.

OSM opening hours differ slightly from the website (website now shows Monday CLOSED, Tuesday–Saturday 10am–4pm, Sunday 11am–4pm; OSM lists Tu-Fr,Su,PH 11:00-16:00; Sa 10:00-16:00) — OSM hours appear inaccurate.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, year-round non-profit tourism attraction with guided farm tours, an on-site market, and family-friendly activities; a useful stop for touring cyclists passing through the Abbotsford/Fraser Valley area.
enrichment_extras.notes: The outdoor petting zoo is free of charge per the FAQ. The Dairy Barn Day Pass and some tour paths are wheelchair accessible; VIP Behind the Scenes and Archway add-on tours have limited accessibility. Dogs are permitted on-site.

Café or food on site.detail: Seasons Farm Market is located on-site and carries EcoDairy milk, vanilla ice cream, EcoFarm ungraded eggs, and Hanks grass-fed beef (per FAQ page)

wow_evidence: Demonstration dairy farm partnered with Science World — tours, free petting zoo, farm market; distinctive family stop.
blurb: Demonstration dairy with tours, petting zoo, and farm market.
